authoritative_data: Runtime owns durable Task records/progress/cancellation/event sequences/quotas; platform support owns logs/preferences/resource paths/build dependency configuration, separate from engineering document state.

allowed_dependencies.rule: Direction is owner depends on these public contracts/ports; concrete adapters are wired only by composition hosts. GUI/CLI/script clients cannot link document/application; no Qt/VTK/SQLite/MCP types in core public interfaces.
allowed_dependencies.authority: docs/architecture/module-dependencies.json plus engineering-skeleton-proposal.md logical responsibility target; additions require future actual build graph verification.

extension_points: Task workers and artifact publishers implement ports with bounded resources.
Optional license/product policy stays a platform adapter.
Build/packaging variants declare dependencies/resources/regression fixtures without introducing vendor types in core contracts.
state_failure_version_rules: This is an L1 draft design contract: no compiled public consumer, BP execution, L2 integration or capability completion is asserted by this file.
All document mutation uses the shared coordinator, document/epoch/revision checks and atomic persistent history; GUI/script/AI cannot bypass it.
Unimplemented advanced capabilities report unavailable; data/reference errors never become a partially committed model.
Two workers/eight queued tasks: ninth pending request returns RESOURCE_LIMIT; records retain transition/event sequence.
Accepted precommit cancel commits no model transaction; postcommit cancel does not roll back.
Restart marks interrupted work explicitly; incomplete artifacts cannot be published as successful.
Task/event/config/resource and dependency manifest versions are frozen; hardware-dependent performance evidence remains pending.
